item.title: YouPro v21.43.5
item.description:
YouTube 21.43.5 | YouProExtra_21.43.5_1.3.1
### Latest Release, ENJOY!! > [!NOTE] > - **YTUHD** is not included. 4K60HDR is available. > - if you're signed out you can sign in manually. > - no iSponsorBlock and YouSlider. (unstable in newer builds) > - Downloads working partially. depending on hardware codecs. > - Liquid Glass Support > > - - - > #### Extra Tweaks: > - `YouPip` `YouSlider` `YTweaks` `YouSpeed` `YouMute` `YouLoop` `YTABConfig` `YouQuality` `YouChooseQuality` `YouGetCaption` > - `Return-YouTube-Dislikes` `DontEatMyContent` `Open in YouTube (Safari Extension)` `Gonerino`
> [!WARNING] > - 21.34.3+ builds require iOS 17+ now.

item.title: YouPro v21.41.5
item.description:
YouTube 21.41.5 | YouProExtra_21.41.5_1.3.1
### Latest Release, ENJOY!! > [!NOTE] > - **YTUHD** is not included. 4K60HDR is available. > - if you're signed out you can sign in manually. > - no iSponsorBlock. (unstable in newer builds) > - for <A15 devices press share button in the arrow down panel and use external player for AV1 videos. > - downloads are unstable for <A15 devices. some will fail due to no av1 codec. > - - - > #### Extra Tweaks: > - `YouPip` `YouSlider` `YTweaks` `YouSpeed` `YouMute` `YouLoop` `YTABConfig` `YouQuality` `YouChooseQuality` `YouGetCaption` > - `Return-YouTube-Dislikes` `DontEatMyContent` `Open in YouTube (Safari Extension)` `Gonerino`
> [!WARNING] > - 21.34.3+ builds require iOS 17+ now.
